{{recipe}}

==Ingredients==
*426 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] [[Cookbook:Ricotta|ricotta cheese]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
*9 g dried [[Cookbook:Mixed Herbs|Italian seasoning]]
*340 g shredded [[Cookbook:Mozzarella Cheese|mozzarella cheese]]
*100 g freshly grated [[Cookbook:Parmesan Cheese|Parmesan cheese]]
*284 g frozen [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Spinach|spinach]], thawed and squeezed dry
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste
*[[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]] to taste
*908 g frozen [[Cookbook:Dough|white bread dough]], thawed

==Procedure==
# Preheat the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 400°F (200°C).
# In a large bowl, mix together the ricotta cheese, eggs, Italian seasoning, mozzarella cheese, Parmesan cheese and spinach. Set aside.
# Divide the bread dough into 8 pieces and [[Cookbook:Dough#Rolling|roll]] each piece out to about an 8-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] circle. Spoon about ½ cup of the ricotta filling onto each circle, fold over and seal the edges. Place onto a greased [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|cookie sheet]].
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for 30 minutes in the preheated oven, or until nicely browned on the tops and bottoms.

steps.text: In a large bowl, mix together the ricotta cheese, eggs, Italian seasoning, mozzarella cheese, Parmesan cheese and spinach. Set aside.

Divide the bread dough into 8 pieces and roll each piece out to about an 8-inch circle. Spoon about ½ cup of the ricotta filling onto each circle, fold over and seal the edges. Place onto a greased cookie sheet.
Bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven, or until nicely browned on the tops and bottoms.
